about.about-me: I'm a frontend developer focused on creating semantic, responsive, and performant interfaces with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. I have a strong attention to detail in translating wireframes and prototypes (Figma) into high-quality code. I use AI Pair Programming as a continuous learning tool to accelerate my growth and deliver faster results, always seeking the balance between functionality, performance, and user experience.
